_source: Piano Companion (lite) 1.6.1028, bundle com.songtive.pianocompanion.lite.osx. Decompiled PianoCompanion.dll + PianoCompanion.Engine.OSX.dll. Every entry is exact (cited) unless 'confidence' says inferred.

liteDetection.effect: Lite build: pro flags (ChordsPro, ScalesPro, ProgressionsPro) are loaded from the saved 'settings' object. Non-lite build: SetProductByType(AllInOne) on every Load().

products.notes: Only card with trial copy and per-week price (price/52).

teaser_unused.note: Defined in the engine, but no call site exists in PianoCompanion.dll (grep). Likely used by the iOS/Android build only (inferred).

purchasePolicy.rules: NewPurchase if neither restored nor replayed; non-subscription restored => AlreadyOwned (grants); subscription restored => AlreadyOwned only if receipt expiry > now and not cancelled, else StaleRestore (does not grant). In Buy() the receipt expiry is passed as null, so a restored subscription during Buy is StaleRestore.
purchasePolicy.restoreQueriesOnly: ItemType.InAppPurchase (GetPurchasesAsync) — subscriptions are not explicitly queried (exact); whether StoreKit returns them anyway is not determinable statically
